questions.text: Please introduce yourself and tell me why you are interested in this role.
What skills do you consider most important for success in this role?
Describe a project or piece of work you are proud of and your contribution.
How would you approach a task you have never done before under a tight deadline?
Walk me through how you solve complex problems step by step.
Tell me about a time you received critical feedback. How did you respond?
Describe a situation where you had to work with a difficult teammate.
How do you prefer to communicate progress and blockers on a project?
What motivates you in your day-to-day work?
Where do you see the biggest challenges in this field over the next few years?
